name: Peruzzi banking house collapses
summary: The Peruzzi compagnia of Florence defaults after Edward III of England, having borrowed ~600,000 florins to finance the early Hundred Years' War, repudiates the debt. The Bardi follow into bankruptcy in 1345.

_quarry.structural_significance: First major medieval international banking crisis; demonstrates the structural risk of sovereign-creditor concentration that recurs through European banking history.
